currentSprintFocus: 2026-08-26 → 27: Documents (M8) redesigned last among the registry modules, same audit → plan → implement process as M3/M4/M6/M7/M5. Phase 1 audit report first (file structure, API contracts, permissions, OCR/portail/traduction workflow), Phase 2 plan informed by a frontend-design pass calibrated toward reusing the existing SICOT token system (internal admin tool, not a fresh brand) rather than a reference mockup's own visual style. New GET /documents/aggregates (didn't exist before); GET /documents list no longer returns texteExtrait/chemin (DocumentListView, column-projected query) — the audit's own payload-size concern, confirmed live. getDocumentCapabilities(role,doc) consolidates scattered role checks. New DocumentActionsMenu (Radix dropdown-menu.tsx primitive) collapses the row-actions link-soup into a '⋯' menu; DocumentWorkspace (Dialog+Tabs, no Sheet primitive exists in this repo) is the new selected-document panel (Aperçu/Informations/OCR/Portail), category editing moved there from the registry. DataTable (shared) gained onRowClick + columnDef.meta.className, reusable by any page. Responsive: Langue/Version hidden <lg, DocumentsMobileCards <md. Fixed the audit's one confirmed regression (upload zone visible to agents) plus two small bugs (mettreAJourCategorie missing 'rapport', dead /portail link). User then caught two real UI bugs live: the '⋯' menu was inert (Radix DropdownMenuTrigger asChild doesn't compose with this repo's Button, built on @base-ui/react, no existing precedent of that combination) and the table header turned white on hover (TableRow's blanket hover:bg-anac-gray, shared with body rows) — both fixed at the shared component level, both confirmed live via one Playwright session. User then asked not to keep doing local browser verification going forward (token cost vs. a manual check the user can do themselves) — saved as a standing feedback memory. See changelog.md's 2026-08-27 entry for full detail.
